front.transcription: FOLLOWED: If you end your turn in a neutral city without an agent, add an agent to your city.
HASSLED: If you end your turn in a neutral city without a safehouse, discard 1 card (after the Draw Cards step).
AIRPORTS ALERTED: You may not do the Unrecorded Flight action from a neutral city.
MONITORED: If you draw 2 neutral City cards at the end of your turn, lose 1 cover.
